events.headline: RUBIO SAYS US EXPECTS TO FINISH IRAN WAR 'IN NEXT COUPLE OF WEEKS'
events.detail: Marco Rubio said US allies were open to helping escort ships through the Strait of Hormuz, which Iran has closed and threatened to charge fees for.

events.headline: POR QUÉ IRÁN MANTIENE EL CONTROL SOBRE EL ESTRECHO DE ORMUZ, PESE A QUE “EL RÉGI
events.detail: En diálogo con LN+, Andrés Repetto analizó el despliegue de tropas de Estados Unidos y la persistencia de la capacidad nuclear del país rival en medio de la guerra en Medio Oriente

events.headline: US DIPLOMAT MARCO RUBIO DENOUNCES SETTLER VIOLENCE, TOLLS IN HORMUZ STRAIT
events.detail: Rubio reiterated President Donald Trump's call for other countries to participate in securing the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: WHY IS IT SO HARD TO PASS THROUGH THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ?
events.detail: Paul Adams explains why it is so dangerous to navigate the strait, one of the world's busiest oil shipping channels.

events.headline: SAUDI, UAE, IRAQ: CAN THREE PIPELINES HELP OIL ESCAPE STRAIT OF HORMUZ?
events.detail: Countries in the Middle East have ramped up oil exports via pipeline to bridge the Strait of Hormuz gap.

events.headline: VÍDEO | CRISIS ENERGÉTICA: ¿HASTA DÓNDE SUBIRÁ LA GASOLINA?
events.detail: La guerra entre EE UU, Israel e Irán dispara el petróleo. El bloqueo de Ormuz sacude el suministro mundial y encarece los combustibles en Europa
